endpoints.summary: Service status. Browsers get this page; other clients get JSON.

format.note: Force a representation instead of using the Accept header

endpoints.summary: Machine-readable catalogue of every endpoint (this page as JSON).
Runs the live probes: every safe GET is called without credentials; results are cached for a few seconds.
Create a customer account and its linked customer profile.
Sign in with email and password (any role) and receive a JWT.
The signed-in user.
Staff edit their own name, email and phone. Changing the email (the login) needs the current password.
errors: 400 blank name / invalid email or phone / wrong or missing current password

endpoints.summary: Change your own password. Your other sessions are signed out; use the returned token for this one. Admins do not need their current password.

newPassword.note: At least 6 characters, different from the current one

errors: 400 wrong current password / too short / unchanged

endpoints.summary: Edit the name, email or phone of a staff account below your rank (managers: waiters and chefs; admins: also managers).
endpoints.access: Handler checks rank: admin > manager > chef = waiter, strictly lower only, never yourself.
errors: 403 account is not below your rank

endpoints.summary: Issue a one-time temporary password for a staff account below your rank. They must set their own on next sign-in, and their sessions are signed out.
endpoints.access: Handler checks rank: admin > manager > chef = waiter, strictly lower only, never yourself.
errors: 403 account is not below your rank

endpoints.summary: An admin sets a new password for a staff account below them, without the old one. Their sessions are signed out.
endpoints.access: Admin only, and only for accounts below admin rank (not other admins).

endpoints.summary: The five stakeholder roles.
Every user account, without password hashes.
Change a user's role or suspend/reactivate them. Admins cannot change their own role or suspend themselves.
errors: 403 another admin (admins manage accounts below them)

endpoints.summary: Remove an account; its tokens stop working immediately. Linked customer records are kept.
The caller's own customer profile with order history. A customer without a profile gets one created (201).
endpoints.access: Staff without a linked customer profile get 404.

endpoints.summary: Edit the caller's own profile; name and email changes also update the login account.
endpoints.access: Other roles get 403.

email.note: Valid, not used by another account

endpoints.summary: Customer ledger, sorted by name, each with order history and spend.
One customer with order history.
Create a customer record (not a login account).
Update a customer record.
Delete a customer record that has no order history (management only).
errors: 409 customer has order history and can't be deleted

endpoints.summary: Menu grouped by category. Guests see active, non-empty categories; staff can ask for everything.

scope.note: "manage" (staff only) includes hidden categories; recipes only for chef/manager/admin

endpoints.summary: Flat list of every menu item. Chefs, managers and admins also get each recipe.
Create a menu item.

modifiers.note: Modifier groups: [{ name, type: single|multi, options: [{ label, priceDelta }] }]

errors: 400 missing fields / unknown category / bad modifiers

endpoints.summary: Update a menu item. Chefs may only change availability.
endpoints.access: Handler limits chefs to available / outOfStockReason.

modifiers.note: Modifier groups: [{ name, type: single|multi, options: [{ label, priceDelta }] }]

endpoints.summary: Replace the dish's recipe (bill of materials) used for stock deduction.
Delete a menu item.
All categories in display order with item counts.
Create a category.
Rename, reorder or hide a category. Sort must be a number; a rejected request changes nothing.
Delete an empty category.
Place an order. Customers order online or at their table; floor staff orders go straight to the kitchen.
endpoints.access: Chefs get 403.

tableId.note: Required for a customer dine-in order

endpoints.summary: Staff order list, newest first.
The signed-in customer's last 50 orders. Other roles get an empty list.
Kitchen display queue (rush first, then oldest) and the ready-for-pickup list.
One order.
endpoints.access: Any staff role, or the customer who owns the order (others get 403).

endpoints.summary: Replace the line items of an unpaid order that has not been confirmed yet.
Move the order through placed > confirmed > preparing > ready > served, or cancel it.
endpoints.access: Per target status: confirmed/served/cancelled need floor staff, preparing/ready need kitchen staff; a customer may cancel their own order while it is still placed. Cancelling a paid order refunds it, so otherwise only a manager or admin may.
errors: 403 role not allowed / paid order needs a manager

endpoints.summary: Set one item's status (kitchen: preparing/ready, floor: served).
endpoints.access: Handler checks the role against the target status.

endpoints.summary: Attach an active dine-in order to a table.
Reprioritise an order in the kitchen queue.
errors: 409 not in the queue / already at the edge

endpoints.summary: Bills with an outstanding / paid-today summary.
Itemised invoice for an order.
endpoints.access: Waiter, manager, admin, or the customer who owns the order (others get 403).

endpoints.summary: Receipt for a settled bill.
endpoints.access: Waiter, manager, admin, or the customer who owns the order (others get 403).

endpoints.summary: Set the tip as an amount or a percentage of the subtotal. Clears any split.
Split the bill evenly or by items; parts always sum to the total.
Undo a split before anyone has paid a share.
One payer settles their share; the bill is paid once every share is.
Record full payment.
Reverse a payment recorded in error (management only, like refunds).
Refund a paid bill in full or in part, with a reason.
Table numbers, seats and zones for customers ordering at their table.
Live floor plan with active orders and the next booking per table. Also refreshes reservation holds.
Add a table.
Change status, assigned waiter or hold; managers can also change number, seats and zone.
endpoints.access: Handler limits layout fields (number, seats, zone) to manager/admin; only active floor staff can be assigned as the waiter.

endpoints.summary: Remove a table without active orders.
Open time slots for a date and party size.
Reservation book. Also refreshes table holds.
The signed-in customer's bookings. Other roles get an empty list.
endpoints.access: Guests get 401; non-customers get an empty list.

endpoints.summary: Request a booking (guests or customers). Fully booked slots return up to three alternatives.
errors: 409 fully booked: { error, alternatives: [{ date, time }] }
429 guests: more than 5 booking requests in 10 minutes from one address (signed-in staff are exempt)

endpoints.summary: Confirm, seat, cancel or mark no-show; move date/time, party size or table.
Cancel a requested or confirmed booking.
endpoints.access: Floor staff, or the customer who made the booking.

endpoints.summary: Ingredient stock with low-stock flags and the dishes that use each one.
Add an ingredient.
Adjust stock by a delta (restock / wastage); managers can also edit details or set a counted stock level.
endpoints.access: Chefs may only send delta; other fields need manager/admin.

endpoints.summary: Remove an ingredient that no recipe uses.
Recent stock movements, newest first.
Suggested reorder quantities for low-stock ingredients.
Submitted purchase orders, newest first.
Submit a reorder form.
Mark goods received and restock every line.
Staff accounts, active and suspended.
Public "join our team" form.
errors: 429 more than 3 applications an hour from one address

endpoints.summary: Application review queue, newest first.
Approve an application: creates the staff account and returns a one-time temporary password.
endpoints.access: Managers approve waiters and chefs; admins may also approve managers.

endpoints.summary: Reject a pending application.
The signed-in staff member's shifts (default: last 7 to next 14 days).
Full rota (default: the next 7 days).
Assign a shift; rejects overlaps and suspended staff. Notifies the staff member.
Reschedule a shift or mark it completed / missed.
Delete a shift.
Per-staff metrics: orders, revenue, tips, prep time, shifts (default: last 30 days).
The caller's clock status: off / working / on break, since when, the current (or today's latest) session and today's shift.
Clock in. Matched to today's shift; later than start + lateGraceMinutes is late.
errors: 409 invalid transition (already clocked in, not clocked in, already on a break, not on a break)

endpoints.summary: Clock out (an open break ends with it).
errors: 409 invalid transition (already clocked in, not clocked in, already on a break, not on a break)

endpoints.summary: Start an unpaid break.
errors: 409 invalid transition (already clocked in, not clocked in, already on a break, not on a break)

endpoints.summary: End the current break.
errors: 409 invalid transition (already clocked in, not clocked in, already on a break, not on a break)

endpoints.summary: Who is working, on a break or off right now, with today's shift.
endpoints.access: Waiters see waiters, chefs see chefs, managers see managers, waiters and chefs, the admin sees all staff.

endpoints.summary: The caller's attendance analytics (summary, day/week/month/hour series, sessions, shifts) and pay estimate for the month of "to".

from.note: Default: first day of the month of "to"

to.note: Default: today; at most a year after "from"

errors: 400 invalid date / "from" after "to" / range over a year

endpoints.summary: One staff member's attendance analytics, with pay when the caller may see it.
endpoints.access: Yourself or the admin: everything including pay. Managers: waiters and chefs only, with pay null. Others get 403.

from.note: Default: first day of the month of "to"

to.note: Default: today; at most a year after "from"

errors: 403 not allowed to see this person

endpoints.summary: Month overview: one row per visible staff member (state, attendance summary, pay), totals, and team series (day, week, hour) for the charts.
endpoints.access: Admin: all staff with pay and payroll. Managers: waiters and chefs, pay and payroll null.

endpoints.summary: Set a staff member's hourly wage.
Add a bonus (or, with a negative amount, a deduction) to a staff member's pay.

amount.note: Non-zero, at most 10000 either way; negative for a deduction

errors: 400 invalid amount / missing reason / invalid date

endpoints.summary: Remove a bonus or deduction.
errors: 404 staff member or adjustment not found

endpoints.summary: Today's headline numbers for the staff overview.
KPI dashboard: trend, top dishes, table turnover, peak hours, inventory health, no-show rate.
The caller's 30 latest in-app notifications (personal and role-wide) with the unread count.
Mark all of the caller's notifications as read.
Mark one notification as read.
errors: 404 not found or not addressed to you

endpoints.summary: Restaurant policy (tax, service charge, points value, hours) and booking time slots.
Update restaurant policy. Numeric fields must be numbers within range (null or blank is rejected); opening hour must be before closing.
